summary: Community on the existing Neon tables: paginated plain-text feed, posts/comments/likes, friends/follows/blocks, notifications, reports, moderator hide/restore/suspend and an audit trail. Ownership, visibility, blocks and roles are enforced server-side, including friend-only room invites and a suspended-user mutation gate. Ada (@s01ada) was granted moderator by owner decision. Two independent browsers posted, liked, commented and blocked; ordinary players got 403 on cross-user edits and moderation; reports reached the moderator queue; hide and dismiss wrote the audit trail.
